releaseNotes: Home UX refinement: stable Library, Anki Review, Reading Stats and More destinations. Anki opens setup when unconfigured; More contains recent books, available saved items, configured OPDS, transfer and Settings, with return-selection restoration. Lyra gains a compact white reading panel, crisp focus outlines, quieter author text and progress/time-left details. Missing covers use text space instead of a black placeholder. Menu pagination fits available height. Existing Minimal/Dashboard direct-button layouts and prior Anki repairs retained. Simulator navigation/visual checks, 52 focused tests and original-X4 production build passed. Physical acceptance pending.
